definitionZh: 位置可见CSS属性可以有条件地隐藏锚定位置的元素,这取决于其是否溢出其包含的元素或视窗.
sourceDefinition: The position-visibility CSS property enables conditionally hiding an anchor-positioned element depending on, for example, whether it is overflowing its containing element or the viewport.
